description: This file implements the RefImsMediaSession class, which manages IMS media session operations such as setting listeners, modifying sessions, sending DTMF signals, and configuring media quality thresholds within the Android radio hardware interface.

classes.name: RefImsMediaSession
classes.description: Class responsible for managing IMS media sessions, including setting listeners, modifying sessions, and handling DTMF and media quality configurations.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the media session listener to handle session responses and events.

methods.name: modifySession
methods.description: Modifies the current media session with the provided RTP configuration.

methods.name: sendDtmf
methods.description: Sends a DTMF digit with specified duration.

methods.name: startDtmf
methods.description: Starts DTMF tone transmission for the specified digit.

methods.name: setMediaQualityThreshold
methods.description: Sets the media quality threshold parameters.
